units.source_text: 表面上我開朗快活，常常逗得大家發笑，其實內心卻晦暗無比，

en.t: Outwardly I was cheerful and lively, often making everyone laugh, but inside I was unbearably gloomy.

units.source_text: 這種毫無辦法的事雖然暗自肯定，但那幅畫除了竹一外，我沒有讓任何人看。

en.t: Although I secretly accepted this helpless truth, I did not show that picture to anyone except Takeichi.

units.source_text: 我不希望讓別人看穿我搞笑背後的陰鬱，更討厭突然被別人小心提防。

en.t: I did not want anyone to see through to the gloom behind my clowning, and I disliked even more the thought of suddenly being treated with wary caution.

units.source_text: 另外，我擔心別人沒有發現這是我的本來面目，而依然被視為一種新的搞笑方式或笑料，

en.t: I also worried that people might fail to realize this was my true self and would still take it as some new style of clowning or a joke.

units.source_text: 這比什麼都讓我痛苦難堪，所以我立刻把那幅畫藏進了抽屜深處。

en.t: That was more painful and humiliating to me than anything, so I immediately hid the picture deep inside a drawer.

units.source_text: 在學校的美術課上，我隱瞞「妖怪式畫法」，

en.t: In art class at school, I kept my monster-like method of drawing hidden,

units.source_text: 以平庸的筆觸，美麗地畫著原本美麗的事物。

en.t: using ordinary brushwork to draw things that were already beautiful in a beautiful way.
